appliedUpdates.description: Documented that backend only fires WS budget alerts for thresholds not yet marked as fired in budget_alert_states table. Added reset command, toast timing guidance (8s auto-dismiss, screenshot at 800ms), budget API upsert pattern (POST not PUT), and search filter UI re-snapshot guidance.

notes: Round 1 was blocked entirely by frontend runtime crash ('global is not defined' from sockjs-client/stompjs). After fix (Vite define global: globalThis), round 2 validated all 16 previously blocked assertions. Search/filter UI (VAL-SRCH-001 to 010): all filters work correctly with AND logic, proper empty states, clear/reset functionality. WebSocket UI (VAL-WS-001, 003, 004, 005, 010): STOMP WS connection established automatically, all three threshold alerts (50%/80%/100%) display as categorized toast notifications. Transaction-triggered alerts (VAL-CROSS-005): creating a transaction that crosses a threshold immediately triggers alert toast via WebSocket.
